annotationRationale: The derivation converts integrality into divisibility modulo 8 and reduces powers in a complete set of residue classes.
sourceMethod: Follows the first official solution, checking residues modulo 8 after clearing denominators. The odd cases are combined using their square remainders.

review.mathCheck: For even inputs, every term of \(Q(m)=8P(m)\) is divisible by 8. For odd representatives, \(m^2,m^4,m^8\equiv1\pmod8\) and \(4m\equiv4\pmod8\), giving \(Q(m)\equiv0\pmod8\). The eight representatives cover every residue, including zero. All four values are integers, choice E.
review.sourceMethodCheck: An originally worded, faithful adaptation of the first official solution 24 on page 14. It retains residue-class checking and expands the even case while correctly grouping the odd representatives. No advanced theorem is required.
review.annotationCheck: Both modular concepts are directly exercised. Clearing denominators and ordinary algebra are appropriate background; all parity and residue cases are covered.
